# Changelog

## 1.5

- Shortcode `[zorgform form="..."]` that renders a Zorgform form on the page
- Overview of all forms and their shortcode on the settings page
- "Cache legen" button on the settings page
- Automatic updates from the WordPress plugins screen
- Hides the form and shows a message when the Zorgform server is unreachable
- Configurable texts for the submit button and form messages on the settings page

## 1.4

- Loads the Zorgform JavaScript plugin on every page once a practice key is set
